gold: Glioblastoma (World Health Organization grade IV) with optic nerve invasion and intraocular extension

selector.rationale: Vitreous biopsy showing hypercellular sample with astrocytic neoplasm and positive immunohistochemistry for glial fibrillary acid protein, oligodendrocyte transcription factor 2, mutant IDH-1 protein, and p53 support the diagnosis of Glioma, with IDH-mutant Astrocytoma being a subtype that also fits some of the findings

rejected.label: Central Retinal Artery Occlusion
rejected.why: While there is evidence of central retinal artery occlusion, it is likely a consequence of the primary disease process rather than the primary diagnosis itself

rejected.label: Glioblastoma
rejected.why: Although some features are consistent with glioblastoma, the presence of mutant IDH-1 and loss of ATRX protein are more characteristic of lower-grade gliomas

rejected.label: Astrocytic Neoplasm
rejected.why: This is a broader category that includes Glioma, and the specific findings support a more specific diagnosis within this category
